basic_info.description: Rare Dolores Heights private backyard (this unit has exclusive use of the entire backyard) includes a two-level 3-bedroom 2-full-bath 1,444 sqft (calculated to the exterior walls) unit with  parking that has interior access. The upper level has a walkout deck. This is the largest unit in this small four unit building. Three units have sold off market. This is the last one. AAA Dolores Heights Location. This is one of the most desirable neighborhoods in San Francisco.
